methodology_notes: Two-anchor OLS uses cross-lab drop and binarization range as per-target predictors of LOTO AUROC. Conflicts and residual contributions are reported as aggregate dataset-wide bounds (0.008 and 0.025 respectively) rather than per-target predictors because they cannot be cleanly factorized at target resolution: label-conflict effects depend on compound-pair overlaps within a target rather than a target-level scalar, and the residual is by construction the unexplained variance after the two anchors plus conflicts. They are therefore retained as aggregate bounds (from prior gap-decomposition analyses) and excluded from the per-target OLS / Shapley attribution.
